reactor_type: traveling-wave-type plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) reactor (MP1000, ASM Genitech)
evidence: For A TO deposition, the Ti- and Al-precursor pulse times were 1 and 0.5 s, respectively, which were determined from preliminary experiments where the GR saturation behavior of each component oxide was confirmed. The ALD reactor pressure was maintained at 3 Torr during deposition. After each precursor and reactant pulse, the chamber was purged with Ar gas at a flow rate of 200 sccm to remove the remaining precursor and reactant gases.
